profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in secure, full-stack solutions. I am a polyglot developer passionate about impactful, mission-driven work. I excel at product ownership from concept to deployment, ensuring security, resilience, and compliance are at the core of the development cycle.

Throughout my career, I've delivered high-stakes projects, including engineering a zero-touch FDA medical device recall system, building foundational features for cardiac monitoring platforms, architecting and building tools for oil refinement optimizations and contributing to essential financial transaction systems.

I am always looking for the right challenges to further hone my skills, and I am committed to making a lasting impact through secure software solutions and a deep understanding of complex system architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned the end-to-end development of key platform features, ensuring security best practices and compliance were core to the development cycle.

Engineered a zero-touch FDA medical device recall system from the ground up.

Architected a scalable patient management UI using OpenSearch to effectively manage thousands of clinic records.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Software Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Regulatory Compliance · Kubernetes · Node.js · Ruby on Rails · Event-Driven Architecture · Docker Products · PostgreSQL · Web Application Security · Redis · Elasticsearch · Microservices · RabbitMQ

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a full-stack developer on long-term embedded projects for key clients in the MedTech and FinTech sectors.

Acted as a core developer for PrepMD, building foundational features for their cardiac monitoring platform.

Contributed to essential financial transaction systems at BNY Mellon.

Delivered a streamlined data management application for StemTrak.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Software Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Regulatory Compliance · Spring Boot · Kubernetes · Node.js · Ruby on Rails · Event-Driven Architecture · React.js · Docker Products · PostgreSQL · Redis · Elasticsearch · Microservices · RabbitMQ

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of monitoring and calculation interfaces for Exxon Mobil's oil refineries.

Built and maintained internal reporting tools to support business operations.

Supported a utility tasking and assignment platform designed for full offline-first capabilities on mobile devices, including complex sync logic for field use where network service was unavailable.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Node.js · Event-Driven Architecture · React.js · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a teamwork-focused web application featuring chat, file sharing, and project management, and integrated it with the company's core live digital web chat technology.

Implemented software solutions with Microsoft Dynamics 365, building robust billing and entitlement portals with deep product integrations.

Excelled in rapidly building full-application prototypes in short sprints, significantly enhancing operational agility.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Contributed to the core email delivery platform, focusing on enhancing system capabilities and security.

Developed new techniques for tracking viewed and opened emails to improve deliverability analytics.

Engineered proper email routing logic and implemented critical safeguards to protect mail servers from malicious use.

positions.title: Software Security Consultant
positions.description:
Contracted as a security consultant after discovering and responsibly disclosing a critical SQL injection vulnerability in the company's school management software.

The software managed sensitive data, including student attendance, grades, medical information, and district records.

Demonstrated the exploit live to the company's development team, showing how the vulnerability allowed for unauthorized viewing and editing of records within the system.

Collaborated directly with their engineers to ensure the vulnerability was fully understood and could be patched.

positions.title: IT Technician Intern
positions.description:
Provided comprehensive IT support for a large school district both over the summer and during the school year.

Leveraged CISCO certifications in Computer Maintenance/Repair and Networking to set up, debug, and repair district computers and network infrastructure.

Entrusted with a "forever hall pass" during the school year to provide on-demand investigation and resolution of computer and network issues for teachers and staff.

Managed critical IT systems, including user authentication, security camera systems, and networked drives.

Implemented and maintained network monitoring and parental control software across all district accounts and computers to ensure student safety and network integrity.

Handled all-tier IT support, from printers and driver issues to system-wide software updates.
